security_audit.summary: Eight static findings are confirmed because their cited ranges direct the agent to install dependencies or execute test, load, Python, and container commands. Eleven findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, code fences, tool names, or UTF-8 Chinese documentation rather than executable or obfuscated content. Active API and load testing also lacks explicit authorization and environment safeguards.

remediation.issue: The skill directs agents to install dependencies and execute project or container commands without a required approval or isolation step.
remediation.suggestion: Require command preview and explicit user approval, inspect dependency files, use an isolated environment, and restrict commands to the agreed test scope.

remediation.issue: Active API and load testing instructions do not require proof of authorization, a non-production target, or resource limits.
remediation.suggestion: Require target authorization, environment confirmation, rate and duration limits, monitoring, and an immediate stop condition before sending traffic.

content.user_title: Plan, Automate, and Run Software Tests
content.value_statement: Manual testing workflows are slow and inconsistent across frameworks. This skill designs tests, creates automation, runs approved checks, analyzes failures, and reports measurable results.
actual_capabilities: Creates test plans and prioritized cases from requirements, user stories, or feature descriptions.
Builds automated UI, API, mobile, and unit tests with established frameworks.
Runs approved tests and reports pass rates, failures, timing, and diagnostic details.
Generates controlled performance tests and analyzes throughput, latency percentiles, and error rates.
Creates CI test stages for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
Analyzes defects, reproduction steps, logs, coverage, and release quality risks.
limitations: Execution depends on available tools, dependencies, credentials, services, and environment access.
API and performance tests require explicit authorization and carefully defined target limits.
Generated tests still require review for product-specific behavior and expected results.
The skill cannot guarantee complete coverage or identify every security and performance defect.

use_cases.title: Validate a New Feature
use_cases.description: Turn acceptance criteria into prioritized functional, boundary, negative, and regression cases before release.

use_cases.title: Add Automated Regression Coverage
use_cases.description: Create and run tests that follow repository conventions, then summarize failures and changed files.

use_cases.title: Assess Release Readiness
use_cases.description: Combine execution results, defects, coverage, and performance measurements into a concise quality assessment.

prompt_templates.title: Create Feature Test Cases
prompt_templates.prompt: Create test cases for [feature]. Include prerequisites, steps, expected results, priorities, boundary conditions, and negative cases. Use a Markdown table.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning from a feature description

prompt_templates.title: Automate Repository Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Write and run [framework] tests for [feature]. Reuse project conventions, report commands, results, failures, and changed files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate test automation in an existing repository

prompt_templates.title: Execute an API Test Suite
prompt_templates.prompt: Test [API base URL] using [framework]. Cover authentication, validation, errors, and schemas. Ask before requests, then report measured results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced API verification with execution controls

prompt_templates.title: Run a Controlled Performance Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a performance test for [endpoint] targeting [QPS]. Confirm authorization, define limits, execute safely, and analyze percentiles, errors, and bottlenecks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced performance analysis for an authorized environment

output_examples.input: Create regression tests for account login and password lockout.
output_examples.output: A prioritized test table covering valid login, invalid credentials, lockout thresholds, recovery, expired sessions, accessibility, and audit events.

output_examples.input: Analyze the latest API test failures.
output_examples.output: A failure summary grouped by endpoint, likely root causes, reproduction details, affected requirements, and recommended next actions.

output_examples.input: Assess whether the orders API meets 200 requests per second.
output_examples.output: An authorized test plan followed by measured throughput, latency percentiles, error rates, observed bottlenecks, and a release recommendation.

best_practices: Confirm scope, expected behavior, environment, and authorization before creating or running tests.
Review commands and generated files before execution, then use isolated test data and environments.
Report actual evidence separately from assumptions, including commands, versions, failures, and unresolved risks.
anti_patterns: Do not run tests, installers, containers, or load tools without explicit approval.
Do not target production systems or third-party services without documented authorization and limits.
Do not hide failed tests, change expectations to force passes, or claim results without execution evidence.

faq.question: Which testing frameworks are supported?
faq.answer: The skill covers pytest, JUnit, Jest, Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, REST Assured, requests, k6, Locust, and similar project tools.

faq.question: Can it run the tests it creates?
faq.answer: Yes, when the required tools and environment are available and you approve the commands and target scope.

faq.question: Can it test APIs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can design and run functional API checks for status codes, schemas, authentication, errors, and response timing.

faq.question: Can it perform load testing?
faq.answer: Yes, but only against authorized targets with confirmed environments, traffic limits, monitoring, and stop conditions.

faq.question: Does it configure continuous integration?
faq.answer: It can generate test stages for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Jenkins, including dependencies and test reports.

faq.question: What information produces the best result?
faq.answer: Provide requirements, repository context, technology stack, environment details, expected behavior, test data rules, and clear acceptance criteria.
